newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somali group says 89 dead in Ethiopia-Somali fight.
newsitem.headline: Somali group says 89 dead in Ethiopia-Somali fight.

text.p: Somali Moslem fundamentalists said on Monday they killed more than 70 Ethiopian troops on Saturday in western Somalia at a cost of 19 Somali fighters killed.
Ahmed Bile Hassan, a spokesman in Mogadishu for al-Ittihad al-Islami (Islamic Union), added Ethiopian troops still held the Somali border town of Dolow and the border village of Melkaray.
Al-Ittihad al-Islam accused Ethiopian troops backed by tanks of seizing Dolow last Tuesday and pushing 20 km (12 miles) into Somalia. There has been no comment from Ethiopia on the reports.
Witnesses said on Monday Moslem fundamentalist militiamen were leaving the capital to reinforce al-Ittihad in the west.
Dolow, 500 km (300 miles) northwest of Mogadishu, was one of three towns seized by Ethiopian troops in a two-day incursion into western Somalia last August to hit al-Ittihad's bases.
Ethiopia said then it might have to hit what it called the "multinational terrorist group" in Somalia again in the future.
